title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Susceptibility Genotype Predicted

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Susceptibility: Predicted susceptibility — by genotype determination technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Genotypic prediction of susceptibility (HIV, HBV, HCV, M. tuberculosis drug resistance mutations). The LOINC filter METHOD_TYP = Genotyping maps to Technique = Genotype determination technique. Parts: LOINC enumeration (81, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = 118588007 |Susceptibility (property) (qualifier value)|, 246501002 |Technique (attribute)| = << 708060009 |Genotype determination technique (qualifier value)|`

purpose.value: Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated.
